title: 01/19/18 - Software Updates
content:
## 01/19/18 - Software Updates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000040127

We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.


## Updates:


- We refactored several core files that make all frontend pages of websites load faster.

- We created a new tool in order to delete the unused / old export files generated by the Member Export Data Add-On.  The tool is located in the Admin Dashboard, in the section called "My Resources".

- The Monitor Add-Ons feature in the Admin has been refactored and the code has been improved to more accurately reflect which Add-Ons have been activated.

- We released the Integrations Tab in the General Settings section on the Admin. With this module site Admins can update their Google API Keys, Recaptcha Keys, Facebook ID and so on. All the credentials updated on the Integrations Tab will be also updated in the Advanced Settings and vice-versa.
